definitions.gloss: decommissioning of a nuclear reactor; scrapping a reactor
definitions.explanation: Permanently shutting down and dismantling a nuclear reactor. Usually paired with にする (to decommission).

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{原子炉|げんしろ}→原子炉：20824_genshiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{廃炉|はいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、{廃炉|はいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: After the accident, decommissioning was decided.

examples.japanese: {廃炉|はいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Decommissioning takes many years and a large amount of money.

notes:
The process of permanently shutting down and dismantling a nuclear reactor. Usually used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廃炉|はいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to decommission a reactor
- {廃炉|はいろ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: decommissioning work
- {廃炉|はいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: for decommissioning to be decided

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧: dismantling — general demolition, not reactor-specific
